## Defining biodiversity data

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width=45%}
> **Artifacts and symbols** collected, stored, and disseminated in order to document the constituent elements of life, extant or extinct, at **any scale of time and space**.

<br />

> These **elements are biological** and encompass anything that **contributes to the structure and function of life at any scale**, from the microscopic to the level of the planet, and to the **continuation of life, that is, its ability to persist and evolve over time**.

:::

::: {.column width=10%}
:::

::: {.column width=45%}
![](images/garnier-tee.png)
:::

::::


::: {.citation}
**Source:** [Garnier _et al._ (2025)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tree.2025.06.004)
:::



## Data, datasets, databases and co

<br>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width=45%}
![](images/data-circles3.png){width=100%}
:::

::: {.column width=5%}
:::

::: {.column width=50%}

<br />


- **(a)** **Data** and **metadata** make up **(b)** **datasets**. 
- Multiple datasets in one location form a **(c)** **database**. 
- **(d)** **Aggregators** compile data from many databases. <br/><br/><br/>


- **Repackagers** transform data in a way that makes it more accessible for all audiences.
- **External users** (e.g. scientists, industries, government agencies etc.) access raw data by going through any or all of these data sharing portals.

:::

::::

<br />

::: {.citation}
**Source:** [Blair _et al._ (2020)](https://doi.org/10.3897/BDJ.8.e32765)
:::

::: {.column width=10%}

## French repositories

It is recommended to prioritize deposits in trusted **thematic repositories**, 
followed by **institutional repositories** and, as a last resort, 
**generic repositories**.

# Biodiversity databases


## Some biodiversity databases

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width=33%}
**GBIF** &nbsp;[{{< fa globe >}}](https://gbif.org/)

- Checklist & occurrence data
- Worldwide
- All taxa (marine & terrestrial)
:::

::: {.column width=33%}
**IUCN Redlist** &nbsp;[{{< fa globe >}}](https://www.iucnredlist.org/)

- Species information
- Conservation status
- Species range map
:::

::: {.column width=33%}
**OBIS** &nbsp;[{{< fa globe >}}](https://obis.org/)

- Occurrence, abundance data
- Cover percentage & biomass
- Habitat, genetic, etc.
:::

::::

<br />


:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width=33%}
**BOLD** &nbsp;[{{< fa globe >}}](https://boldsystems.org/)

- DNA sequences
- Link to specimens (attributes, taxonomy, collection/location, images)
:::

::: {.column width=33%}
**GenBank (NCBI)** &nbsp;[{{< fa globe >}}](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genbank/)

- Genetic sequences
:::

::: {.column width=33%}
**MoveBank** &nbsp;[{{< fa globe >}}](https://datarepository.movebank.org)

- Individual tracking locations
- Worldwide
- All taxa
:::

::::

<br />


:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width=33%}
**TRY** &nbsp;[{{< fa globe >}}](https://www.try-db.org/TryWeb/Home.php)

- Trait plant
- Informations by traits, species, datasets, regions
:::

::: {.column width=33%}
**GloBI** &nbsp;[{{< fa globe >}}](https://www.globalbioticinteractions.org/)

- Interaction data, including predator-prey, pollinator-plant, pathogen-host, parasite-host
:::

::: {.column width=33%}
**Map of Life** &nbsp;[{{< fa globe >}}](https://mol.org/)

- Species profile
- Regions, provinces, protected areas
- Biodiversity trends and patterns
:::

::::

## Biodiversity databases

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width=50%}
> Data repositories [...] and databases [...] are the basis for progress but 
> are **not representative** in their taxonomic and geographical coverage 
> **of the Earth’s biodiversity**[^Gonzalez].

> In recent decades, the availability and accessibility of biodiversity data and the **profusion** of portals, tools, and platforms through which to utilize them have increased rapidly [...] it can create **confusion** in navigating biodiversity data within a highly **saturated landscape**[^Kemp]

> Our review showed that each biodiversity database holds 
> **unique scientific value** because they cover different spatial extents, 
> taxonomic groups, and record types[^Feng].

:::

::: {.column width=50%}
![**Source:** Feng X _et al._ (2022) <https://doi.org/10.1111/geb.13497>](images/feng-2022.jpg){width=80%}
:::

::::

[^Gonzalez]: [Gonzalez A _et al._ (2024)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41559-023-02171-0)
[^Kemp]: [Kemp H _et al._ (2026)](https://doi.org/10.1146/annurev-environ-121224-084200)
[^Feng]: [Feng X _et al._ (2022)](https://doi.org/10.1111/geb.13497)
